notes: Manufacturer data sheet used as primary source is the ZyPer4K-XS PDF (dated for Z4KDECC3XS, the copper-Ethernet sibling), which explicitly lists Z4KDECF3XS in the same product line/chassis with an identical front-panel port set except the network connector: the copper model's "10Gb PoE Ethernet" RJ45 port is replaced on the -F3XS fiber variant by a 10Gb fiber "Media Transport" port using a hot-swappable SFP+ cage (per ZeeVee's Z4KSFP10G... transceiver line and product-page description). This substitution is corroborated by the ZeeVee product page for Z4KDECF3XS and a reseller (Creation Networks) spec summary. Fiber reach depends on the SFP+ module used (multimode 850nm ~300m or single-mode 1310nm ~10-20km) — module not bundled. Audio-out jack confirmed as 3.5mm unbalanced stereo (not RCA) via reseller spec table; grade omitted on it (analog, ungraded). HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per explicit "HDMI 2.0 with HDCP pass-through" spec. Ethernet utility port grade set to eth-1g ("1 Gb Utility"); fiber Media Transport port grade set to eth-10g ("10Gb" fiber). USB port is a single USB 2.0 Type-A used specifically for extending USB/HID between paired ZyPer4K-XS/XR encoder-decoder units, not a general host port; graded usb-2.0 per spec. Power input is 12V DC via locking barrel connector (approx. 8W) — mapped to dc-barrel as the closest listed connector id, noting the real connector is a locking (twist-lock) DC barrel variant, not a plain barrel jack. Desktop unit (7.8 x 4.6 x 1.9 in), not natively rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted (optional Z4KRACKXS kit holds 8 units in 6RU, but that's an accessory, not the unit's native form factor).

ports.name: HDMI 2.0 Output
ports.note: Labeled "Media Output / HDMI 2.0 OUT" on copper sibling panel; identical on fiber variant. HDCP pass-through, embedded audio up to 8ch LPCM.

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo analog breakout, labeled "AUD-OUT" on panel.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Single USB 2.0 Type-A; used to extend USB/HID between paired ZyPer4K-XS/XR encoder and decoder.

ports.name: 1 Gb Utility Port
ports.note: Utility/control Ethernet, separate from the main 10G media link.

ports.name: Media Transport (Fiber)
ports.note: 10Gb fiber port for video/audio/control, via hot-swappable SFP+ cage; replaces the copper model's 10Gb PoE RJ45 port. Requires a ZeeVee SFP+ transceiver module (multimode ~300m or single-mode ~10-20km), not bundled.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: 12V DC, locking (twist-lock) barrel connector; ~8W consumption. External AC power supply included in box.
